song.name: The Prisoner's Wrath
song.plot: Nyktoros rages within the seal. After Endless Night (the seal completes and Anya traps him), the trapped Void god thrashes against his cage — but the Living Lock holds. The crisis point where the seal is tested, and where Anya's sacrifice is proven necessary.
song.analysis: New song, written lore-first. POV: Nyktoros (the prisoner) raging, or the omniscient witness of the seal holding. Best served as Nyktoros's furious POV — the trapped god screaming against the walls, met by the silence of the ward. Anchors: the seal, the Underworld/the prison, Anya's vigil rising/begun (the Living Lock), Nyktoros's fury, the lock that holds. No escape, no victory for the Void — the seal HOLDS (the whole point). Must not suggest Anya's vigil is over/that she fails. Place after Endless Night (seal set) and before Haunting Life (vigil begins). Structure: Verse → Chorus → Verse → Chorus → Bridge → Chorus → Outro. Dark, violent, claustrophobic. Suggested Suno direction: raging storm monster — distorted low choir, percussive chains, wailing screams, sub-bass detonation, yet a ceiling that never breaks.

section.name: Verse
section.reworked: Caged in the cradle of the deepest dark, I beat the walls of my eternal hold. I am the Void, I am the dying spark, And they have shut me in the lightless cold.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: I am the prisoner's wrath, unchained, I shake the bars, I test the pain. But every strike the lock repays, The Living Lock that holds the days.

section.name: Verse
section.reworked: A scholar dares to seal me in the deep, A girl who fell from the celestial glare. I will not break, I will not fall to sleep, I will not bow — but still the walls are there.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: I am the prisoner's wrath, unchained, I shake the bars, I test the pain. But every strike the lock repays, The Living Lock that holds the days.

section.name: Bridge
section.reworked: Scream, and meet the silence, Strike, and feel the wall. The seal is not a weapon, It is a vow that will not fall.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: I am the prisoner's wrath, unchained, I shake the bars, I test the pain. But every strike the lock repays, The Living Lock that holds the days.

section.name: Outro
section.reworked: It holds... it holds... The Living Lock that holds the days.
